items.headline: Defense powers No. 3 Notre Dame past SMU 24-3
items.description: — Notre Dame’s defense held SMU to its lowest point total since 2016, and the No. 3 Fighting Irish ground out a 24-3 victory on Saturday night.

items.headline: Notre Dame loses safety Luke Talich to injury in first quarter vs. SMU
items.description: Notre Dame starting safety Luke Talich left the Fighting Irish's game against SMU in the first quarter with an apparent right leg injury suffered on the opening drive of the game Saturday night in South Bend, Indiana.
